channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Nas eleições, não fiquem em dúvida, votem em quem representa os interesses de vocês, diz Lula
item.description: On Friday, April 4th, President Lula emphasized that Brazilians should vote for candidates who represent their interests, acting as a mirror of the citizen's desires. He stressed the importance of choosing leaders aligned with the country's aspirations.

item.title: Lula defende reformas no Judiciário, mas programa não detalha mudanças
item.description: Lula advocates judicial reforms but his platform lacks specific proposals. He criticized judicial delays and signaled openness to discussing changes, though the campaign hasn't responded to inquiries about new initiatives. The STF crisis, involving messages between Moraes and Vorcaro, fuels debates on transparency and judicial reform.

item.title: Poder360 divulga gratuitamente campanha institucional do TSE
item.description: Since August 20, Poder360 has publicly disclosed, free of charge, the institutional campaign of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE). The banners direct users to the official TSE page with information about the 2026 elections. This pro bono initiative aims to inform Brazilian citizens and reinforce the digital newspaper's commitment to democracy and citizenship.

item.title: Master: Caiado defende investigação sobre suposta propina envolvendo Kassab
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) supported opening an investigation into allegations of bribery involving banker Daniel Vorcaro, who allegedly made illegal donations to the 2022 campaigns of Bolsonaro and Tarcísio. During a debate, Caiado stated that everyone mentioned, including his running mate Gilberto Kassab, should be investigated, emphasizing the need to clarify the accusations regardless of who is involved.

item.title: Atlas: Lucas Ribeiro tem 42,2% das intenções de voto ao governo da PB; Efraim, 30,9%; Lucena, 19,8%
item.description: Lucas Ribeiro (PP) leads gubernatorial polls in Paraíba with 42.2%, followed by Efraim Filho (PL) at 30.9% and Cícero Lucena (MDB) at 19.8%, according to AtlasIntel survey. In hypothetical runoff scenarios, Ribeiro maintains an advantage over both opponents.

item.title: Zema critica fim da “taxa das blusinhas” sem compensar empresas brasileiras
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema criticized the Senate's approval to end the 'blusinhas tax' on international purchases under $50, claiming it harms Brazilian businesses and benefits foreign platforms like Shein and Shopee. He advocates for tax compensations for domestic retailers and warns about rising bankruptcies in Brazil.

item.title: Lula estuda indicar Couto para o STF; entenda a relação dos dois
item.description: President Lula is considering appointing desembargador Ricardo Couto, interim governor of Rio, to the STF following the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias. Couto is viewed as a technically neutral option with strong public approval in Rio due to his transparency agenda and anti-corruption efforts.

item.title: Cid e Wagner lideram disputa para o Senado no CE, diz Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolho survey released on September 4, 2026 shows Cid Gomes (PSB) leading the Ceará Senate race with 24% of voting intentions, followed by Captain Wagner (União Brasil) with 20%, both technically tied. Luizianne Lins (Rede) ranks third with 17%, within the margin of error. The survey interviewed 1,204 voters between August 31 and September 2, 2026.

item.title: Governo brasileiro não descarta encontro casual entre Lula e Trump na ONU
item.description: The Brazilian government does not rule out a casual meeting between Presidents Lula and Trump during the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in September in New York, where Brazil traditionally opens the debates. So far, there is no request for a bilateral meeting between the teams, but the central theme of Lula's speech is expected to be the defense of Brazilian sovereignty.

item.title: Caiado: “Não sou um personagem criado para disputar uma eleição”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, presidential candidate from PSD, stated he is not a character created to run for office, emphasizing his track record and contrasting himself with Flávio Bolsonaro during a forum hosted by Folha and UOL.

item.title: AtlasIntel: Lula lidera com folga no Ceará e abre 26 pontos sobre Flávio Bolsonaro no primeiro turno
item.description: A new AtlasIntel poll shows Lula leading in Ceará with 51.6% in the first round, widening his lead over Flávio Bolsonaro, who scored 25.7%. In the runoff, Lula maintains a lead of approximately 15 points.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Reforma no STF, impeachment de Mendonça e pressão sobre Moraes
item.description: President Lula advocates for a deep judicial reform in 2024, while allied lawmakers consider filing impeachment charges against Supreme Court minister André Mendonça. The discussion also covers pressures on minister Alexandre Moraes.

item.title: Zema defende prisão de Alexandre de Moraes após revelações sobre relação com Vorcaro
item.description: Romeu Zema called for the arrest of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes amid a crisis involving a R$129 million contract between the minister's wife and banker Daniel Vorcaro. Zema labeled the allegations as 'rotten fruit' and demanded punishment for all involved regardless of party. His comments follow police discoveries of messages between Vorcaro and authorities, with Moraes requesting investigations against Minister André Mendonça for alleged misconduct.

item.title: Arruda recorre ao TSE para validar candidatura ao governo do DF; TRE foi unânime ao negar registro
item.description: José Roberto Arruda (PSD) appealed to the TSE after the DF Electoral Court rejected his gubernatorial candidacy due to administrative misconduct linked to the Pandora's Box operation. His defense alleges the convictions are consecutive and that the 2025 Clean Record Law clears ineligibility after 12 years, allowing his candidacy.

item.title: Eleitor de Cury rejeita três vezes mais continuidade de Lula do que volta de família Bolsonaro, mostra Quaest
item.description: The latest Quaest survey shows that voters for Augusto Cury reject Lula's continuation (60%) three times more than Bolsonaro's return (22%). Cury, rising from 2% to 10% in voting intentions, takes third place among candidates. Additionally, 71% of Cury's voters disapprove of Lula's government, and 66% believe the economy has worsened over the past 12 months.

item.title: Lula tem 54% e Flávio, 16%, em 1º turno no CE, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Quaest survey shows Lula leading in Ceará with 54% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 16% in the first round. The survey interviewed 900 voters between August 31 and September 3, 2026.

item.title: Brasil pode recorrer a mecanismos de reequilíbrio previstos no acordo Mercosul-UE
item.description: Brazil expresses frustration with the European Union following the suspension of beef and animal product exports, considering the use of rebalancing mechanisms provided for in the Mercosul-EU agreement. While mentioning reciprocity in an official note, the government does not rule out activating trade agreement mechanisms to rebalance relations, especially after the EU withdrew quotas offered in May.

item.title: Cid Gomes e Capitão Wagner lideram para o Senado no Ceará, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 4, 2026 shows Cid Gomes (PSB) and Captain Wagner (União Brasil) tied technically with 23% and 20% of voter intentions, respectively, in the race for two Senate seats in Ceará. The survey interviewed 900 voters between August 31 and September 3, 2026, with a margin of error of ±3 percentage points and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Lula lamenta adiamento de votação do fim da 6×1 no plenário do Senado
item.description: President Lula regretted the postponement of the vote on the PEC ending the 6×1 workday in the Senate, decided by Davi Alcolumbre, who prioritized the agenda for after the first round of elections. Despite the delay, Lula highlighted that Congress approved other government priorities during the concentrated effort week.

item.title: Atlas: Omar Aziz tem 33% no 1º turno contra 29% de Maria do Carmo; veja números do Amazonas
item.description: AtlasIntel poll shows Omar Aziz (PSD) leading gubernatorial voter intentions in Amazonas with 33.2%, followed by Maria do Carmo (PL) at 29.2%. In the presidential race, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is statistically tied with Lula (PT) among Amazonas voters. Public approval of the federal government remains low, with 57% disapproving of Lula's administration.

item.title: Crise no STF vira tema da campanha presidencial: veja o que disseram os candidatos
item.description: The STF crisis, intensified by the Master case, has become a central theme in the 2026 presidential campaigns, with candidates proposing anything from lawful investigations to radical institutional changes. Lula advocates for judicial reform and investigations without premature convictions, while others, such as Flávio Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema, suggest more decisive measures, including arrests and ministerial resignations.

item.title: Pesquisa AtlasIntel mostra liderança de Flávio Bolsonaro entre os eleitores do Amazonas
item.description: A new AtlasIntel poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading voter preference in Amazonas with 41.3% in the first round, followed by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 39.2%. In the second round, Bolsonaro maintains his lead with 48%, against Lula's 41.3%, according to the survey conducted between August 28 and September 3 with 1,185 voters and a margin of error of three percentage points.

item.title: Ibovespa tem maior valorização semanal desde janeiro
item.description: The Ibovespa recorded its largest weekly gain since January, rising 5.4%, driven by expectations of interest rate cuts and electoral debates. Analysts note the opposition is seen as more likely to implement structural fiscal reforms, potentially pressuring for reductions in the Selic rate.

item.title: O novo pedido de impeachment contra Alexandre de Moraes no Senado
item.description: Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE) filed a new impeachment request against Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, alleging abuse of office and conflict of interest related to contracts between his wife and Banco Master. The complaint, backed by 20 lawmakers, asks the Senate to open a formal investigation that could lead to removal and disqualification from public office.

item.title: Caso Master: Viana pede providências em relação a denúncias contra Moraes
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana requested Senate action regarding the Banco Master case following allegations involving Daniel Vorcaro and Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. He called for Moraes' impeachment, sought his and Attorney General Paulo Gonet's testimony before the Senate, and filed a complaint against Davi Alcolumbre for not scheduling impeachment proceedings. Viana also proposed an extraordinary session to discuss the matter.

item.title: Candidata do PL vence todos no 2º turno no Amazonas, aponta pesquisa
item.description: AtlasIntel poll shows PL candidate Maria do Carmo beats all opponents in a potential runoff for Amazonas Governor. Leading the first round with 29.2%, she defeats both Omar Aziz (PSD, 33.2%) and Roberto Cidade (União Brasil, 20.1%) in simulated head-to-head matchups. The poll was released on Friday, April 4th.

item.title: Arruda recorre ao TSE após TRE-DF barrar sua candidatura ao governo
item.description: José Roberto Arruda, PSD candidate for the Federal District government, appealed to the TSE after the TRE-DF rejected his candidacy registration. The decision by the electoral court will be reviewed by the higher electoral authority in the coming days.

item.title: Lula questiona Alcolumbre por adiar votação do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: President Lula questioned the Senate's decision not to bring to the floor the proposal ending the 6×1 scale, previously approved in committee. In an interview with Rádio Progresso, he expressed discomfort with the postponement of the vote under Davi Alcolumbre's leadership.

item.title: Quaest: para 57%, ausência de candidato em debates não afeta decisão do voto
item.description: A Quaest survey shows that 57% of voters do not consider a candidate’s absence in debates as a decisive factor in their vote. However, 37% say that not participating in debates reduces their likelihood of voting for the candidate. Lula leads with 37% of voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 29%.

item.title: Ministério Público Eleitoral abre apuração sobre eventual abuso de poder de Renan Santos
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry has opened a preliminary investigation into Renan Santos over suspected abuse of power and illegal fundraising, linked to delays in registering social media accounts used in his campaign. The delay sparked criticism and a temporary suspension of digital campaigning, lifted days later. The candidate's defense requests the investigation be expanded to all candidates.

item.title: Como a esquerda tem reagido ao cerco contra Moraes no escândalo do Master
item.description: The Brazilian left takes a cautious stance regarding the accusations against Minister Alexandre de Moraes in the Banco Master scandal, avoiding outright defenses and emphasizing impartial investigations and the presumption of innocence. Some leaders, such as Edinho Silva and Zeca Dirceu, stress the need to investigate all involved parties, maintaining a balanced position between institutional respect and demands for transparency.

item.title: Lula diz esperar que PEC do fim da escala 6×1 avance após o primeiro turno das eleições
item.description: President Lula stated he expects the approval of the PEC ending the 6×1 electoral scale after the first round of elections, criticizing the slow progress in the Senate. Lula highlighted that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre promised the vote will take place in the plenary, but expressed dissatisfaction with the measure not advancing this week.

item.title: Como estava a disputa entre Lula e Bolsonaro nas pesquisas a um mês da eleição de 2022
item.description: The Datafolha poll released on September 1, 2022, showed Lula with 45% of voting intentions against Jair Bolsonaro's 32% in the first round, with a 13 percentage point lead. In the second round, Lula led with 53% against Bolsonaro's 38%. In 2026, the dynamics have changed significantly, with Lula (38%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (33%) in a more balanced race.

item.title: Viana quer fim do recesso do Senado diante da crise no STF
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG) calls for an end to the electoral recess in the Senate to address the STF crisis. He proposes that lawmakers return to Brasília next Tuesday to discuss the institutional situation and pressure the government.

item.title: USA Rare Earth conclui compra da Serra Verde, em Goiás
item.description: USA Rare Earth has completed the acquisition of 100% of Brazilian rare earth miner Serra Verde for $2.8 billion, advancing its strategy to diversify the global rare earth supply chain beyond China. The deal integrates the sole Brazilian producer of essential magnetic elements into the company's portfolio, with plans to scale annual rare earth oxide output from 4,000 to 6,400 tons by 2026. This move aims to meet growing demand for critical materials in sectors such as renewable energy, AI, and national defense.

item.title: Lula avalia indicar Ricardo Couto ao STF
item.description: President Lula is considering appointing Rio de Janeiro's interim governor Ricardo Couto to the STF, aiming to overcome the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias. This move would help avoid scandal-related associations and ease parliamentary tensions, as Lula emphasizes impartial investigations.

item.title: Crusoé: Censura em campanha
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Dias Toffoli suspended the electoral advertising of Renan Santos's (Mission) campaign, ordering its suspension through any channels. The decision directly impacts the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Associação pede que STF derrube decreto mineiro que restringe publicidade de bets
item.description: The National Association of Games and Lotteries (ANJL) filed a lawsuit at the Supreme Federal Court against a Minas Gerais decree banning betting advertisements in public spaces and state events, claiming federal overreach and violation of the principle of legality. The case (ADI 8014) is handled by Minister Flávio Dino and seeks the annulment of Decree 49.279/2026.

item.title: Quando votar é uma escolha: o direito de comparecer ou não às urnas
item.description: The text explores how optional voting, granted to 16- and 17-year-olds, illiterate individuals, and those over 70, turns electoral participation into a personal choice. Through the stories of José da Silva, 72, and Martina Matteo Ferreira, 16, it shows how some choose to continue voting out of conviction, while others participate for the first time with critical awareness. The scenario reflects a transformation in the Brazilian electorate, with an increase in optional voters in the coming decades.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que ‘sem dúvidas’ apoiaria Tarcísio ao Planalto em 2030
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he would support Tarcísio de Freitas for the presidency in 2030, calling him a key figure on the center-right. The comment followed a joint event in São Carlos, strengthening electoral alliances. Flávio has advocated ending reelection, signaling openness for new candidates.

item.title: Zema critica fim da taxação das blusinhas sem contrapartidas para empresas nacionais: 'isonomia é fundamental'
item.description: Romeu Zema criticized the end of taxation on international purchases up to US$ 50, calling the measure an 'absurdity' for favoring foreign companies over Brazilian ones. At a meeting with retail business leaders, he emphasized fair competition and warned about the rising number of judicial recoveries and bankruptcies in Brazil. The approved MP includes an assessment mechanism for the economic impacts of the exemption.

item.title: Lula vai usar mote 'A Força que Une o Brasil' para desfile de 7 de setembro
item.description: The federal government announced that the 7th of September parade in Brasília will use 'A Força que Une o Brasil' as its central motto. The phrase will be displayed on the Esplanada dos Ministérios, which is being prepared for the event. The date holds symbolic significance for the country and the Lula administration (PT).

item.title: Candidatos à Presidência arrecadam R$ 88,8 mi a 1 mês da eleição
item.description: Presidential candidates raised R$ 88.8 million one month before the 2026 election, accounting for 7.69% of the spending cap. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with R$ 43.7 million, followed by Lula (PT) with R$ 35.3 million and Caiado (PSD) with R$ 2.9 million.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula visita as obras das galerias do Cinturão das Águas do Ceará
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva visits the Cinturão das Águas do Ceará gallery construction site in Crato, accompanied by ministers and local officials. The event is scheduled for 3:20 PM at the Santuário Nossa Senhora do Rosário de Fátima parking area.

item.title: 30 anos da urna eletrônica, símbolo das eleições brasileiras
item.description: In 2026, the electronic voting machine turns 30 in Brazilian elections, marking a transformation in voting and tallying. Its trajectory, begun in 1996, reflects debates on security, transparency, and accessibility.

item.title: Quaest mostra ‘goleada’ de Lula sobre Flávio Bolsonaro no Ceará
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 4, 2026 shows President Lula (PT) leading by a wide margin over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) among Ceará voters, with a margin of error of three percentage points. The poll, filed with the Electoral Court, indicates Lula would receive between 51% and 54% of voting intentions, while Flávio would reach 16%, depending on the scenario analyzed.

item.title: Moisés Selerges: ‘É possível acabar com a escala 6×1 em todos os setores’
item.description: Moisés Selerges, former president of the Metalworkers Union and federal candidate backed by Lula, advocates expanding the 6×1 shift reduction to a 40-hour week across all sectors, citing productivity and technology gains. He proposes forming a 'workers' bench' in Congress to push these reforms and address labor precarity in digital platforms.

item.title: A aposta do PT na neutralidade ‘pró-Lula’ do Centrão no Rio
item.description: The PT bets on the neutrality of centrist leaders in Rio to contain support for Flávio Bolsonaro, with a strategy of alliances aimed at electing Eduardo Paes and isolating the PL candidate. A survey shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio in the first round, with 34% and 36% of voting intentions, respectively.

item.title: Em evento no Planalto, Gonet exalta “comunhão” dos Três Poderes
item.description: Paulo Gonet, Brazil's Attorney General, praised the 'harmony of the Three Powers' at a Planalto event, emphasizing collaboration to strengthen justice institutions. The event coincided with a public dispute between ministers Alexandre Moraes and André Mendonça over investigations involving Banco Master.

item.title: As primeiras pesquisas presidenciais após o escândalo envolvendo Moraes e Vorcaro
item.description: Following the scandal involving Supreme Court justices and banker Daniel Vorcaro, polling firms are preparing to release new surveys for the 2026 presidential race. The forecasts are expected to reveal whether the case affects voter intentions for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, who currently lead the polls.
